haikus.haiku:
Warm bagels rising,
Cream cheese spreads like soft whispers,
Friends gather and share.
Happy #NationalBagelfestDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Voices rise like song,
Colors splash in warm sunlight,
Hearts beat as one strong.
Happy #OneVoiceDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright blooms dance with glee,
Words weave through the sunlit air,
Laughter fills the day.
#HappyBirthdayGeorgeBernardShaw from @ClamBakeSanta

Winds of thought do dance,
Colors of dreams intertwine,
Wisdom blooms like spring.
#HappyBirthdayCarlJung from @ClamBakeSanta
